decisions.reason: As a flagship product shown on the home page in both observed years and tightly aligned with the firm's strategic shift toward multichannel cloud messaging, it likely meets or is close enough to aspiration levels to justify continued support.

Its dedicated page in both observed years suggests meaningful commitment and acceptable performance, and although it is somewhat more adjacent to the core than A, the firm likely keeps it while organizational slack still allows learning.

This service fits the installed base and regulated customers' interoperability needs, so even with only modest prominence and some risk of falling short of aspirations, its resource demands are likely low enough to continue for now.

As a low-prominence fax-related feature that is close to but not central to the future innovation direction, it is the strongest candidate for reallocation if results are below aspiration and management searches for better uses of resources.

Threat protection reinforces the firm's secure messaging position in regulated markets, and despite limited website prominence, its strategic fit and complementarities make retention more likely than exit.
